verdict.rationale: Spline docs describe an in-editor 'AI Agent' that builds and edits 3D scenes from natural-language descriptions—creating objects, materials, lighting, animation, and interactivity directly through the editor—plus 'Hana' for screen design and AI texture generation, all first-party built-in assistants rather than external tools. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of AI Agent quality/reliability beyond vendor docs.
